$comment: Claude Code plugin marketplaces vendored into caches/claude-plugins by scripts/vendor-plugins.py. Only plugins whose files live in the repo are kept (no network to fetch the rest). Remote-only MCP connectors in those plugins are disabled so they don't error offline; skills, commands, agents, hooks and LSP configs are untouched. 'enable' lists the plugins switched on by the install scripts; every other kept plugin is browsable in /plugin. 'name' renames a vendored marketplace whose upstream name is reserved for Anthropic's GitHub sources. 'skills' lists plain skill repos whose <path>/* folders are copied into ~/.claude/skills.

lsp.$comment: Language servers the enabled LSP plugins call. npm ones are seeded into the npm cache and installed globally; bin ones go to ~/.local/bin.
